responsibility: Implements the bridge from decoded crate metadata into rustc’s external query and crate-store interfaces. This file turns per-item metadata tables in `CrateMetadata` into `Providers`/`ExternProviders` results, supplies untracked `CStore` accessors for external definitions, macros, spans, and paths, and installs hooks that map stable crate and expansion hashes back to upstream `DefId` and hygiene data.
